dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Steady and symmetrical narrowing of the 2D planar profile from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and symmetrical with no localized bulges or indentations visible at the pixel interface with the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform dark slate-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple faint, light-colored linear marks (rake marks) are visible across the mid-to-anterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of healed linear rake marks visible as narrow, light-toned streaks against the dark-grey epidermal baseline.
